scope: G2 remediation/verification, G1/G3 re-verification; G4 conditional on G1-G3 PASS
notes: native-installation-probe has an explicitly disclosed collection bug and omitted unrelated error paths; it is not used for gating. native-host-confirmation is the corrected host evidence.
No system installation/repair, production dependencies, spike scaffold/build/run, Desktop Shell implementation or Git commit/push was performed.
Process wrapper exit 0 means collection completed; inventory absence and missing SDK components still block G2.
HTTP cmdlets and filesystem/registry cmdlets do not have separate executable exit codes. Their returned values/errors and enclosing process results are recorded.
G3 PASS covers checked runtime and declared metadata compatibility; dependency resolution, transitive locks and native build/runtime remain unverified.

records.command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$vswherePath = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'
$records = [ordered]@{VswhereExists=(Test-Path -LiteralPath $vswherePath)}
if ($records.VswhereExists) {
  $output = & $vswherePath -products '*' -format json -utf8
  $records.InventoryExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  $records.Inventory = (($output -join "`n") | ConvertFrom-Json)
  $output = & $vswherePath -products '*' -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath
  $records.CppProbeExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  $records.CppInstallations = @($output)
  $output = & $vswherePath -products '*' -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -property installationPath
  $records.MsbuildProbeExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  $records.MsbuildInstallations = @($output)
  $output = & $vswherePath -all -products '*' -format json -utf8
  $records.AllInventoryExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  $records.AllInstallations = @(($output -join "`n") | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object installationPath,installationVersion,isComplete,isLaunchable,isRebootRequired)
}
$sdkRoot = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Windows Kits\10'
$includeRoot = Join-Path $sdkRoot 'Include'
$libRoot = Join-Path $sdkRoot 'Lib'
$records.SdkRoot = $sdkRoot
$records.IncludeExists = Test-Path -LiteralPath $includeRoot
$records.LibExists = Test-Path -LiteralPath $libRoot
$records.IncludeVersions = @()
$records.LibVersions = @()
$records.SdkChecks = @()
if ($records.IncludeExists) {
  $records.IncludeVersions = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $includeRoot -Directory | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)
  foreach ($sdkVersion in $records.IncludeVersions) {
    $checks = [ordered]@{Version=$sdkVersion}
    foreach ($relative in @('Include\VERSION\um','Include\VERSION\shared','Include\VERSION\ucrt','Lib\VERSION\um','Lib\VERSION\ucrt','Include\VERSION\um\Windows.h','Include\VERSION\shared\sdkddkver.h','Include\VERSION\ucrt\stdio.h','Lib\VERSION\um\x64\kernel32.lib','Lib\VERSION\ucrt\x64\ucrt.lib')) { $part = $relative.Replace('VERSION',$sdkVersion); $checks[$part] = Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $sdkRoot $part) }
    $records.SdkChecks += [pscustomobject]$checks
  }
}
if ($records.LibExists) { $records.LibVersions = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $libRoot -Directory | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name) }
$scanRoots = @((Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Microsoft Visual Studio'),(Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio')) | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ }
$records.ScannedRoots = @($scanRoots)
$records.NativeFiles = @()
if ($scanRoots.Count -gt 0) { $output = & rg --files --hidden --no-ignore --iglob cl.exe --iglob link.exe --iglob MSBuild.exe --iglob VsDevCmd.bat @scanRoots; $records.NativeScanExit = $LASTEXITCODE; $records.NativeFiles = @($output) }
$records | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
exit 0
